parameters.content:
# Stage 1 · Fred character style refinement

One prompt → Fred’s actual woman.png character reference + warm environment reference → one 16:9 GPT Image 2.5 Flare result.

The image prompt locks the reference character’s rounded-square head, small square/rectangular eyes, raised worried brows, short straight neutral mouth, compact simple body, bold black outlines, flat fills, and minimal shading. This stage is still one image per request; no batch planner, database, n8n Data Table, or upload step.
